name: banshee-feature-review-pipeline
description: End-to-end Banshee feature workflow: EARS spec ambiguity check -> parallel implementation -> clean-context multi-model code & physics review -> PBT validation.

steps.name: Analyze Spec Requirements for Ambiguity & Conflicts
steps.prompt: Run spec correctness check across .kiro/specs/ to verify there are no ambiguous or conflicting EARS requirements before implementation.

workers.prompt: Implement or update defensive parsers and fixtures in packages/feeds/ and run parser PBTs.
Implement UI updates in apps/web/ following .kiro/steering/haunt-design.md (AA contrast, Field Mode, English-only copy).

steps.name: Clean-Context Multi-Model Physics & Code Review
steps.prompt: Review packages/engine/ in a clean context window against .kiro/steering/space-physics.md and .kiro/steering/honesty.md. Flag any unit, frame (GSM vs GSE), or staleness violations.

steps.name: Skeptic Red-Team Grounding Check
steps.prompt: Red-team packages/engine/src/explainer.ts and verify no ungrounded numbers can bypass verifyGroundedNumbers().
